each component in DVLA-RL, as shown in Table 4. It is observed that (1) Using only attribute-level

as effective discriminative cues. Adding description-level semantics further improves accuracy across
datasets, showing the complementarity of local and global guidance. (2) The progressive Top-k
selection strategy yields additional improvements (e.g., +1.1% on CUB 1-shot), indicating that
iteratively refining the template helps suppress irrelevant attributes and enrich semantic grounding.

especially in the 5-shot setting. (4) The best results are achieved when all components are combined,
where DVLA-RL attains 81.69%/88.25% on miniImageNet, 87.18%/90.59% on CIFAR-FS, and
91.93%/95.06% on CUB. These results confirm the necessity of both dual-level semantic construction
and adaptive fusion, and highlight the effectiveness of their joint integration.
